findings.title: Popup retry is not bound to the unchanged production builder
findings.evidence: The candidate changes popup-retry-1 command_bytes to synthetic production-command:p2-popup-add and row_bytes to synthetic production-row text. The unchanged serviceRecipe produces command SHA 27fcd174df3f214502bbca1e67b0eb366c361c11e1f5ae5c0c48d7a987582501 and retry registry-row SHA c89f8ac7430f4e5342fbffb23cd5ce4aa54f2151e38b3e46af7035aea13fc6c3; the candidate records 809c1a5ed1be729808d335c8c18dbfdee3ccd73d9454e4739b91e256572def37 and 17e8a4acc32f21825eb0642d7e7a832889ec10b9591c0a05795e2dfa8cf6a018. The six original rows match the pure builder, but the authorized retry does not.

findings.title: Preflight-to-normal interleaving can create a second normal request
findings.evidence: An adversarial FakeService that creates another normal request immediately after create_preflight causes recover_or_adopt to call create_normal again; the observed result was normal_calls=2. The controller does not re-inspect same-target/suite candidates or acquire the unchanged builder's artifact lock between preflight persistence and normal creation.

findings.title: Mismatched command/row candidates are not fail-closed
findings.evidence: A same-target/suite normal request with the same source digest but wrong command_bytes is excluded by exact_candidates, not rejected by _inspect. recover_or_adopt then created a new normal request; observed normal_calls=1. The required source/argv/rowtuple mismatch guard is therefore absent. command_digest and row_digest are also not checked against the bytes used for adoption.
